title: A RESTORE CODE LEAVES THE FLOOR CRATES BEHIND
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. Items dropped on the Undercroft floor are written down so that a reload brings them home to the stash. A restore code replaced the whole save but left that list, so the reload after a restore put the old character's floor crates into the restored character's stash: items that character never owned. The list now goes with the save it came from: the crates leave the floor at the restore, and UNDO still brings them home to the old character.
now: A restore code no longer hands the floor crates of the replaced save to the restored character.
